## About
Morris Automotive is Dave Morris's shop on Colorado Ave in Santa Monica. We look after drivers from Santa Monica, Pacific Palisades, Venice and all of West Los Angeles, and Dave is always glad to talk with you directly about what your car needs.
Our mechanics are all ASE certified and keep up with ongoing diagnostic training, so we can keep pace with how complex cars have become. We aim for a high level of professional service without losing the personal touch.
Beyond the shop, the team has volunteered with SkillsUSA California, helping students who are interested in the trade. We hold a 4.9 rating from 733 Google reviews, and we would like to earn yours too.

## Services
- Scheduled maintenance: Preventive maintenance based on your car's factory recommendations, including oil changes, fluid checks, belts, filters and more. Not sure what your car is due for? Give us a call.
- Factory service and repairs: Diagnosis and repair for most cars and trucks, from brakes, batteries and cooling systems to electrical trouble, check engine lights and transmission service.
- Air quality treatment: A fast, inexpensive treatment for bacteria, mildew and mold in your car's ventilation system and cabin. Ask for it next time you are in for service.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We are open Monday through Friday, 8 AM to 6 PM, and closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can you help me get my car to the shop?
A: Yes. We can schedule a tow truck or a local shuttle service for you.

Q: What makes do you work on?
A: We work on Toyota, Nissan, Honda, Acura, Infiniti, Mazda, Chevrolet, Ford, Dodge, Subaru, Hyundai, Chrysler and GMC.
